title: Baselines First
outcome: By the end, I can explain baselines first using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Make a simple baseline earn its place before claiming a better classifier.
given: Training labels: healthy, healthy, spotted. Majority baseline predicts healthy. Validation references: healthy, spotted, healthy, spotted.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Fit baseline
steps.detail: Training majority is healthy: 2 of 3 labels.

steps.label: Compare candidate
steps.detail: Supplied candidate predictions healthy, spotted, spotted, spotted match 3/4: 75%.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Supplied candidate predictions healthy, spotted, spotted, spotted match 3/4: 75%. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.change: Change the third candidate prediction from spotted to healthy.
counterfactual.prediction: Candidate becomes correct on all 4 validation cases.
counterfactual.reason: Only the previously wrong third decision changes; baseline stays fixed at 2/4.

student_task: Can the candidate’s training accuracy replace this validation comparison? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: No. Compare candidate and baseline on the same held-out cases and references; training fit answers a different question. Changed-case check: Candidate becomes correct on all 4 validation cases. Only the previously wrong third decision changes; baseline stays fixed at 2/4.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: These supplied predictions illustrate comparison. No actual model was trained, and four cases are limited evidence.
review_note: Reviewed Baselines First against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
